usage.usage_scope: root_sdk_session_only; child, OCR and tool costs may be missing

assessment: Reconstruction of inline and offline observations is complete and largely unambiguous across all 24 scoped run units (EXP001-EXP012, R01/R02): offline assay sample times (378 sample-time cells) and inline sensor streams share one elapsed-hours clock family per run, and the ProcessParameters stream provides an alignment backbone with 377/378 sample times mapping to exactly one clock cell within one thousandth of an hour (the EXP008/R02 final sample at 216.0 h is the single exception; its ProcessParameters clock ends at 215.983 h). Original values carry cell-level provenance throughout, verified at source for load-bearing cells. Unresolved mappings are enumerated: trailing stream ends (EXP001 thirty-second streams ending nearly six hours before the final sample (certified trailing-gap metric); EXP011/R01 permittivity 15 h short; EXP011/R02 online feed ending at 67.139 h so 9 of 17 samples lack feed observations, with the glucose assay stopping at 67.0 h), isolated misses on irregular or phase-shifted clocks (EXP003 16.5 h, EXP005 46.5 h, EXP006 142.5 h, EXP009 95.0 h, EXP012 136.0/167.0 h), and backwards-clock runs whose alignment requires explicit time-reordering consent. Specialist characterization resolved the screening candidates: EXP004 holds one clock-rewind at ~134-135 h per run with one hour of data re-logged under repeated labels with fresh values (offline mappings stay unique; R02 block not yet source-verified); EXP002/007/012 backwards steps are single thirty-second write-order pairs that do not affect mappings; EXP003 shows a sustained backwards clock segment with an adjacent zero-value region at 141.5-142 h; constant feed/agitation flags match batch-designated runs and setpoints; the EXP010 SEM endpoint is a quantized-column property; EXP006/R01 shows an O2-specific aeration stop while sparging continues; EXP011/R02's viability endpoint is the tail of a real progressive collapse coincident with the feed/glucose stops at ~67 h. Causes remain competing hypotheses: recipes, controller/historian logs, calibration records, sample-chain records and replicate-level assay data are not in the scoped package. Advisory severity proposal: MEDIUM (data-integrity impact on timeline reconstruction in EXP003/EXP004 and the unexplained EXP011/R02 decline); final severity is policy-derived and no approved routing policy is configured in this scope. Human review required; no disposition, release or manufacturing change is proposed or approved.
cross_scope_synthesis: Shared patterns: all twenty-four run units use the same sheet families and one elapsed-hours clock family per run; offline CellAnalysis assays are complete at every scheduled time; the ProcessParameters stream is the most reliable alignment backbone (377/378 offline sample times map to exactly one clock cell within one thousandth of an hour, the sole exception being EXP008/R02's final sample at 216.0 h whose ProcessParameters clock ends at 215.983 h while its R01 sibling covers the same sample). Source file names designate EXP003/004/008/009 as batch runs and EXP010-012 as fed-batch, which explains the constant zero cumulative-feed-weight flags (batch runs log no feed; their NaOH scales still accumulate, showing live logging) and the fixed 100 rpm agitation setpoint in EXP009/R01; the EXP010/R01 compactness-SEM endpoint is a property of a quantized SEM column. Exceptions with material reconstruction impact: (1) EXP004 R01/R02 each contain one clock-rewind at ~134-135 h (Time steps back roughly an hour) with one hour of data re-logged under repeated labels carrying fresh values - offline mappings stay unique because no offline time falls in the window, but the inline timeline is ambiguous between the two copies and R02's block is not yet source-verified; (2) ten runs carry backwards permittivity/turbidity clocks - characterized as single thirty-second write-order steps with continuous values in EXP002/007/012 (cells source-verified), but a sustained backwards segment near 141.5 h plus an adjacent zero-value region in EXP003/R01, and row-level characterization still missing for EXP001 R01/R02 and EXP009/R02; (3) trailing stream ends (EXP001 thirty-second streams 5.74 h short, EXP011/R01 permittivity 15 h short, EXP008/R02 ProcessParameters one minute short, EXP011/R02 online feed ending at 67.1 h); (4) irregular or phase-shifted clocks leave isolated offline times unmapped (EXP003 16.5 h, EXP005 46.5 h, EXP006 142.5 h, EXP009 95.0 h, EXP012 136.0/167.0 h); (5) offline MediumAnalysis assays (glucose, lactate, ammonium) are truncated relative to the sample schedule in every experiment. Substantive cross-source observation: EXP011/R02 combines a progressive viability collapse (91.73% peak at 48 h to exactly 0.0 at the final five samples), the glucose minimum and rising ammonium, and the coincident feed-log/glucose-assay stops at ~67 h - the one candidate where the flagged endpoint reflects a real decline rather than an artifact; its cause (actual feed stop versus logging stop versus independent biological failure) remains open. EXP006/R01 shows an O2-specific aeration stop while air/CO2 sparging continues at the final timestamp. Duplicate-run asymmetries flagged by screening (EXP001 flat-zero C channel at 2155kHz, EXP005 non-positive reflection, EXP008 early fitting-error spike) are acquisition/analysis artifacts; none evidences a process failure and run equivalence is not established. Missing evidence across the whole scope: recipes, controller/historian logs, calibration and probe-service records, sample-chain records and replicate-level assay data are absent from the package, so intended-versus-artifact explanations for every stream-end, clock and signal anomaly remain open.

candidate_reviews.reason: EXP001 C (2155 kHz) paired peak difference (200% by screening formula) is driven by a regime difference: EXP001/R02 reads 0.0 at every one of 24150 timepoints (first cell verified 0) while R01 spans -14.2 to 8.38; no peak-timing or process event is implicated; dead-channel/acquisition asymmetry remains unconfirmed without calibration records.

EXP008 Fitting Error (Cole fit RMSE) paired difference (screening: 457.25 vs 0.2593) reflects an early-run spike in R01 (max at row 332; series mean 0.34) against a flat R02 (0.2426-0.2593); the asymmetry is an acquisition/analysis artifact candidate, not a sustained process difference; no offline assay contradicts.

EXP005 Reflection paired difference (R01 peak 0.0 vs R02 0.1104; screening symmetric difference 200%) comes from a sign-offset regime: R01 never exceeds 0.0 (min -0.1606, mean -0.1271) while R02 spans -0.0378 to 0.1104; acquisition asymmetry between nominal duplicates; design equivalence not established.

EXP002/R01 clock_quality: characterized - two permittivity plus four turbidity backwards transitions, all single thirty-second out-of-order steps (e.g. row 2925: 24.35833333333333 -> 24.35 h, cells source-verified), values continuous (Alpha constant across rows 2921-2930), every grid value present exactly once, no offline sample time within tolerance of a step, and all fifteen offline times still hit the permittivity clock exactly; write-order artifact, not a probe reset.

EXP007/R01 clock_quality: characterized - two permittivity plus three turbidity backwards transitions, all single thirty-second steps (row 19471: 162.2361111111111 -> 162.2277777777778 h, cell A19471 independently transcribed), values continuous through the transitions, no duplicated grid values, no offline-time ambiguity; write-order artifact.

EXP012/R01 clock_quality: characterized - one single thirty-second step per sheet at row 1915 (15.94194444444445 -> 15.93361111111111 h) in both permittivity and turbidity, values continuous; the permittivity clock is otherwise irregular (~45 s implied interval), which is why four offline times lack a permittivity row within tolerance and CO2 misses 136.0 h; write-order artifact plus irregular ticking; one junction cell (A1915) could not be independently source-verified within budget - disclosed.

EXP004/R01 constant Cumulative feed weight: exactly 0.0 g at first, middle, post-rewind and last cells; consistent with batch operation (EXP004_batch.xlsx) and with the NaOH sheet logging normally; the unit additionally carries the single clock-rewind event at 134-135 h, which is the material data-integrity item for this run, not the feed constant.

EXP011/R02 Viability Mean endpoint: the last value is verified exactly 0.0 (cell F18, t=195 h), but it is the tail of a progressive collapse from the 91.73% peak at 48 h through 38.47% at 67 h to 0.0367% at 125 h and exactly 0.0 over the final five samples, coincident with the glucose minimum (0.9945 g/L at 67 h), a rising ammonium trend (11.49 mM at 67 h to 48.93 mM at 195 h) and the feed-log/glucose-assay stops at ~67 h; the endpoint flag marks a substantive decline, not a reporting artifact; cause unresolved (H-1/H-6).

EXP010/R01 Avg. compactness SEM endpoint: last value verified exactly 0.0 (cell K24) but the SEM column is quantized (only 0, 0.003333, 0.005774 occur) with SEM zeros at nine of twenty-three timepoints across the whole run while the Mean at the last row is 0.82 (series maximum); the endpoint change is an expected property of the quantized SEM column, not a process signal.

EXP006/R01 Aeration rate O2 endpoint: last value verified exactly 0.0 (cell J12789) at 214.117 h with the final four rows all 0.0 and peak 0.667633 sL/h at 150.8 h; at the same final timestamp air (1.557863 sL/h), CO2 (0.454088 sL/h) and total aeration continue, so the O2 stream stops specifically while sparging continues - an operational change whose reason (recipe step vs fault) is not in scope.

EXP009/R01 constant Agitation rate: exactly 100.0 rpm at the first and last cells over the full series (min=max=100.0) - consistent with an intended fixed setpoint in a batch-designated run; no fault indication, no recipe record in scope to confirm the setpoint value.

EXP003/R01 constant Cumulative feed weight: exactly 0.0 g at first and last cells over a live thirty-second log, while the same workbook's NaOH scale accumulates to 30.04 g - the scale logs live, and the constant zero feed is consistent with batch operation (EXP003_batch.xlsx); no stuck-scale indication, though recipes are not in scope to confirm batch operation was intended.
